question.question: Which of the following are valid approaches for scheduling GPU-accelerated machine learning workloads in Kubernetes?

options.text: Using the NVIDIA device plugin to expose GPUs as extended resources
Setting resource limits and requests for nvidia.com/gpu
Using node selectors to target nodes with GPU labels
Configuring CPU limits only, as GPUs are automatically detected by the scheduler
Applying taints to GPU nodes and tolerations to ML pods

question.explanation: Kubernetes schedules GPU workloads by exposing GPUs as extended resources via the NVIDIA device plugin (opt1). Pods must request nvidia.com/gpu in their resource limits/requests (opt2). Node selectors (opt3) and taints/tolerations (opt5) are standard mechanisms to constrain pods to GPU-enabled nodes. GPUs are not automatically detected by the scheduler without the device plugin and explicit resource requests, so opt4 is incorrect.
